summary.text: Bob Norris is the Republican incumbent state senator for the Franklin District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A former Franklin County sheriff, he served in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 before joining the Senate.

paragraphs.text: Robert Norris lives in Sheldon, Vermont, graduated from Bellows Free Academy and earned an A.S. in criminal justice from the Community College of Vermont in 1994.
His career experience includes work as the Franklin County sheriff.
Norris represented Franklin 4 in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 and has been a state senator since 2023.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Economic Development, Housing and General Affairs Committee and the Senate Judiciary Committee, where he is vice chair.
